# Lena Marsh

Café manager since 2022. Runs the front of house, the rota, the till and the counter team, and is in charge whenever I am in the basement or away.

## How we work together

Lena owns the rota in Deputy and publishes it by Thursday ([[rota-principles]]). We talk every morning at 07:15 before the doors open and do a longer catch-up on Fridays after close. She sends me notes about staffing, complaints and the counter, which I file here ([[lena-note-on-saturday-staffing]]). She is the person most likely to tell me how a decision will land with customers, and she was right about the lunch cut ([[team-meeting-2026-02-05]], [[menu-review-2026-04-09]]).

## Current threads

- Staffing the extra pavement covers if the licence comes through ([[pavement-seating-licence]]); her estimate of 6,000 to 8,000 EUR of extra summer takings is in that project.
- Front of house training plan for 2026 ([[front-of-house-training-plan-2026]]).
- Christmas preorder counter and collection rota ([[christmas-preorders-2026]]).

## Background

Lena came from managing a busy coffee shop and joined us as a supervisor in 2021, becoming café manager in 2022. She knows the regulars by order if not by name, reads the Square figures more closely than I do ([[square-pos-sales-data]]), and is the one who notices when the counter is understaffed before the queue says so ([[lena-note-on-saturday-staffing]]). She worked 22 of 26 weekends in the second half of 2025; since March 2026 she has two weekends a month off.

## Notes

- Led the move to Deputy ([[rota-system-switch]]).
- Level 2 food safety and allergen awareness, renewed 2025.
- Keyholder; opens on Saturdays and Sundays.
